intro: A three-minute checkpoint on the first half of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: packing and unpacking. The tutor gives you six items, one at a time. For three of them you get a dense nominal phrase (die Verschiebung des Termins wegen Krankheit des Referenten) and say it as a full sentence with the matching conjunction; for the other three you get a sentence and pack it into one nominal phrase with the right preposition and the genitive, or into a passive substitute (sein + zu, sich lassen). It listens for the conjunction or preposition that matches, the case inside the phrase, and the register. One item, one answer; say 'Ende' if you need to stop early.
tips[0].title: Unpack: preposition → conjunction, genitive → subject
tips[0].text: die Verschiebung des Termins wegen Krankheit des Referenten → Der Termin wurde verschoben, weil der Referent krank war.
tips[0].check.why: The preposition wegen unpacks into the conjunction weil, which opens a clause with the verb at the end.
tips[1].title: Pack: verb → noun, subject → genitive
tips[1].text: Die Firma reagierte schnell, deshalb blieb der Schaden klein. → Dank der schnellen Reaktion der Firma blieb der Schaden klein.
tips[1].check.why: The verb becomes a noun (Anstieg), the subject a genitive, and the adverb a declined adjective: der deutliche Anstieg.
remember[0]: Unpack: wegen → weil, nach → nachdem, genitive → subject.
remember[1]: Pack: verb → -ung noun; subject → genitive; adverb → adjective.
hook: Turn dense official noun phrases into plain spoken sentences and back again, out loud, in about three minutes.
